semanticQueries.query: Foundation models that predict labels or numeric values on unseen tabular datasets by conditioning on example rows, without training a new model for each dataset.
Improve in-context prediction for tabular and relational data by selecting relevant training rows, retrieval, context compression, ensembling or efficient inference.
Adapt pretrained tabular foundation models to a new dataset using fine tuning, parameter efficient adaptation, distillation, calibration or test time optimization.
Estimate causal effects, discover causal graphs, answer counterfactual questions or optimize decisions from observational tabular data using foundation models.
Convert unstructured text and semantic information into tabular features, match entities and schemas, or improve structured prediction using language models.
Evaluate reliability, distribution shift, uncertainty, practical deployment and business applications of general purpose models for tabular and relational prediction.
